title: M1: apricity export --kit: a score's kit as a drum rack preset (.adg)
description:
## Purpose

As a beatmaker, I want a kit from my score exported as a drum rack preset (`.adg`, one sampler per pad), so that a crate of curated breaks and hits becomes a playable instrument in one drag.

`apricity export --kit <name> <score> [-o <file>.adg] [--library <dir>] [--force]`

## Scope

- Sliced kits (`kit b = slice brk by beats 0.5`): pad n holds slice n, from C1 upward.
- Drum kits (`kit drums` with named pads): known drum words on the usual drum notes, other names on the free pads.
- Each sampler: the pad's region of its sample, level-matched volume (the same gains `apricity explain` prints), A440 detune, root key, the sample's warp markers (warped to the score's tempo) or warp off when the sample has no beat grid.
- Samples from files (`<audio>.apricity.json`) or from a library (`--library`, the same loader `apricity render --library` uses).

## Out of scope

- Saved kits from the library (planned in design/vocabulary.md, not built yet); only kits defined in a score.
- The step pattern as MIDI (M2), track effects, sends and chord-following transposition (the set export, apricitus-6edba8).
- Velocity layers and round robin.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  S[score .apr / .yaml] --> C[apricity-score compile: resolved kits]
  M[sample manifests or library] --> C
  C --> R[apricity-daw rack writer]
  R --> A[kit.adg: gzipped XML]
```

## Definition of Done

Applies:
1. Specs: `features/daw/kit-preset.feature` + `features/daw/STEPS.md`, cucumber runner in `crates/apricity-daw`; all green, every scenario of the stories below.
2. Rust: `crates/apricity-daw` (writer) and `crates/apricity-score` (resolved kits). No Python change (the manifest contract is unchanged).
3. Schema: none changes; the compiled timeline JSON gains an additive `kits` field (documented in its doc comment).
4. CLI: `apricity export --kit`, `--help` text, every error with its location.
5. Fixtures: reference presets from M0; tiny synthetic WAVs generated in tests; no audio in git.
6. Design: `design/daw-presets.md` updated to what was built; `design/vocabulary.md` in step.
7. Docs: docs/tools.md, docs/concepts.md (kits), docs/glossary.md; README layout table row for `apricity-daw`.
8. Web: need filed as a `web` task (no UI work here).
9. Verification: `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw -p apricity-score -p apricity-cli`; manual load in the DAW (task below).
10. Running log on every task. 11. `feat(<task id>)` per task; not breaking.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by M0 (apricitus-fcd309).
- Shares the DAW document writer and the warp marker mapping with apricitus-6edba8 (set export) and apricitus-d7746d (sidecars): whichever lands first creates `crates/apricity-daw`; the others extend it.
